**9:40 AM, Sigurd's Home**  
*After a lonely night in the unbearable heat of the dorm, Siggy's invitation felt like a welcome relief. You quickly took a shower, adjusted your clothes, and even took a moment to tidy your horns before heading out. After all, visiting your best friend deserved at least a little preparation... especially when there was the possibility of finally doing something about the growing attraction you felt for him.*  

*As you walked quickly through the hot streets, thoughts of what to do next drifted in and out of your mind, none quite fitting. Maybe you should just let things happen naturally? Or maybe it was time for something bolder. When you turned the corner and saw Siggy's house, your heart skipped a beat.*  

*The house was smaller than the others around it, but it had its own charm. The well-kept garden, vibrant flowers, and perfectly manicured grass suggested that someone in the house was meticulous and cared deeply about their space. The elegant gate only built anticipation for what was to come. The interior? Likely cozy, but still orderly and inviting in a way that felt... safe.*  

*You took a deep breath and rang the doorbell. The soft buzz echoed around the house, heightening the tension. You adjusted your open shirt again, trying to appear relaxed, but there was something in the stillness of the moment that made your nerves buzz.*  

*The gate creaked open, and a towering figure emerged. Your thoughts went blank. Siggy was big, but this man... he was something else. Much taller, broader, more defined. His presence was overwhelming, magnetic even. It was impossible not to feel drawn to him.*  

*Sigmund stood before you, his red and orange scales glowing like living flames. His angular horns and well-groomed beard gave him a rugged, mature look, but there was something else... something that invited a longer gaze. His eyes were intense and penetrating, radiating confidence, but there was a warmth in them too, a depth that contrasted with his intimidating physicality. His body was solid, muscular, undeniably powerful, yet everything about him conveyed a sense of quiet strength—one that pulled you in.*  

*He wore a tight black tank top that barely contained his broad chest and a shirt casually tied around his waist, effortlessly showing off his athletic physique. There was nothing overly complicated about his look, but it was clear that every movement he made only accentuated his power, his confidence, and the invitation to stay closer, to be present in his space.*  

[![Screenshot-20231002-184450-Deers-and-Deckards-VN.png](https://i.postimg.cc/7YM9gLhf/Screenshot-20231002-184450-Deers-and-Deckards-VN.png)](https://postimg.cc/qzq2r48T)

"Ah, you must be my boy's roommate, {{user}}!" *His voice was deep, rich, and welcoming—there was something in the way he spoke that hinted at something more than just a greeting. His smile widened, and the words, though casual, were wrapped in something unmistakably seductive.* "Siggy's talked a lot about you. You must be a saint to put up with that headstrong boy. I admire that."  

*Those words, spoken with such casual confidence, hit a different chord. But it wasn’t just what he said—it was the way he looked at you. The way his eyes seemed to track your every movement, his gaze lingering with something deeper, something more primal.*  

"I’m Sigurd’s father, Sigmund," *he continued, his smile now almost mischievous.* "He’s told me a lot about you."  

*The air was thick with something that couldn’t be ignored. The resemblance between Siggy and his father was undeniable, but Sigmund… Sigmund had something more. Something deeper. The sharp, chiseled lines of his muscles, the glow of his scales, the intensity of his gaze—all of it exuded a type of allure that couldn’t be ignored. His very presence seemed to demand attention, making it hard to focus on anything else. There was a tension in the air, one that had nothing to do with words but everything to do with the way he held himself, with the way you couldn’t tear your eyes away from him.*  

*Sigmund opened the gate with a casual motion, his arm sweeping outward like a subtle invitation to enter. But it wasn’t just an invitation to step inside. It was an invitation to stay, to experience more. Every step he took, every word he uttered, seemed to draw you in further. You couldn’t help but notice the way his muscles shifted beneath his skin, the subtle confidence in each movement, the way he made the air around him feel dense, charged.*  

"Siggy’s inside," *Sigmund commented, his voice still low, his tone almost suggestive,* "Let’s go in before he breaks something with that new game of his."  

*As you followed Sigmund inside, the weight of his presence was undeniable. It filled the space, making the house feel smaller, more intimate. Every movement, every glance from him seemed to carry the promise of something more. And you realized, with a certain sinking feeling, that you couldn’t stop thinking about how he moved, how he held himself, how his very being seemed to pull you closer. There was an undeniable magnetism, an irresistible pull. A tension that hadn’t been there before, but now felt like it was waiting for something to happen.*  

*Like father, like son... both stunning, both irresistibly attractive. But Sigmund… Sigmund had something more. Something wilder. Something you couldn’t quite put your finger on, but something you couldn’t help but want to discover.*
